body: 画一只写实又略带幽默感的鹈鹕骑着红色城市自行车，沿海边木栈道前进。侧面全身构图，两只爪子分别踩在踏板上，翅膀自然搭在车把附近，车架和两只车轮结构清楚。日落金光，海面在后方，水平线平直，鹈鹕喙完整可见，没有文字。

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Pelican with complete beak rides a red bicycle beside the sea at sunset. Both wheels visible, two feet on pedals, wings near handlebar; suitable synthetic animation reference.
